sermon.title: Work that Endures
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: This message teaches that Jesus is the only foundation and each believer’s work will be tested by fire. Through Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who would not bow to the golden image and walked unhurt in the furnace with one like the Son of God, the speaker urges purposing in our hearts daily to serve God, presenting our bodies as living sacrifices and keeping ourselves holy as God’s temple.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Delivered by a speaker other than Pastor Kincer (likely Michael Silla—confirm). Points to check: “first Corinthians 13:14” for 3:14; Daniel 3:17 wording “and he will deliver us”; 1 Corinthians 3:16 “do you not know”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: “we don’t need to comply” with government when it’s wrong (Romans 13); women prostituting themselves or men stepping over people for money; pushes to accept homosexuality and sex outside marriage “not okay”; legal marijuana and alcohol; a father who blacked out drunk while watching his daughter.

And King Nebuchadnezzar sent word to gather together the satraps, the administrators, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the officials of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which King Nebuchadnezzar had set up. scriptures.text_nkjv: Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you? If anyone defiles the temple of God, God will destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which temple you are.

faqs.question: Can someone else grow your relationship with Jesus for you?
Whom are we laborers together with?
Who is like the wise man?
faqs.answer: Whoever hears Jesus’ sayings and does them.

faqs.question: How will each one’s work be revealed?
What is another word for serve?
What did the fourth man look like?
What does Romans 12:1 ask?
faqs.answer: Present your bodies a living sacrifice.
